qs.q: Which academic department is primarily associated with the lead authors of the Victoria case studies text?
o: Department of Child Health and Paediatrics
Department of Community Health and Epidemiology
Department of Internal Medicine and Surgery
qs.e: The text explicitly acknowledges the Department of Child Health and Paediatrics as the primary home institution of the lead authors. The other departments are not the main affiliation credited for the text.

qs.q: Who authored the Foreword for the Victoria Case Studies paediatrics book?
qs.e: Prof. Fredrick N. Were wrote the Foreword, introducing the book as a must-read for undergraduates. The other individuals listed are either authors, contributors, or chapter reviewers.

qs.q: Which of the following clinical specialties is listed first in the table of contents of the Victoria Case Studies book?
qs.e: Emergency Medicine is the first major section listed in the table of contents, appearing right before neonatology and respiratory medicine. It also houses the beginning of the case studies.

qs.q: Which entity is credited as the publisher of the Victoria Case Studies book?
qs.e: ZionPearl Publishers is credited as the designer and publisher of the book in the publication details. The other entities are prominent publishing houses not linked to this text.
